scripts.deploy: npm run build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --env ""
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env ""
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.build:hosted: vite build --config vite.sites.config.js --base=/ --outDir dist/client && node scripts/build-server.mjs
